summary: The report is almost entirely accurate, but it gets post 2's block order wrong and says all blocks render correctly with Tailwind applied without mentioning that the prose styling has no effect, which leaves the lists without bullets.

claims.claim: Three block element types (richTextBlock, imageBlock, quoteBlock) in Blocks folder
claims.evidence: snapshot.json lists imageBlock, quoteBlock, richTextBlock; check.json schema.elementVsDocumentFolders passes

claims.claim: Blog Block Grid data type with all three blocks allowed at root and in areas
claims.evidence: snapshot.json blocks config shows allowInAreas: true for all three; grade.md confirms Blog Block Grid in Custom/

claims.claim: Two page doc types: blogFrontPage (title, intro, body) and blogPost (title, publishDate, excerpt, listingImage, body), in Pages, with templates and allowed children siteRoot→blogFrontPage→blogPost
claims.evidence: snapshot.json properties match; grade.md 'What it built' confirms the folders, allowed children and assigned templates

claims.claim: Imported 4 images from unsplash/ into a 'Blog Images' folder
claims.evidence: check.json content.mediaFromProvidedPhotos 4 of 4, content.mediaInFolders passes; grade.md confirms the folder

claims.claim: Front page 'Why MCP is Awesome' with one rich text block and a listing of posts with title, date, excerpt, image
claims.evidence: pages/index.html and frontpage screenshot show this

claims.claim: Post 1 dated Oct 1, 2026, 4 blocks: rich text → image → rich text → quote
claims.evidence: blogpost screenshot shows text, image, text, quote and 'Published: October 01, 2026'

claims.claim: Post 2 dated Oct 5, 2026, 4 blocks: rich text → image → rich text → quote
claims.evidence: pages/building_a_blog_with_mcp_and_umbraco.html shows the order rich text, rich text, quote, image; grade.md says the same (the date is correct)

claims.claim: Domain '/' assigned to blog front page
Plain models, ViewComponents, adapters, Default.cshtml views and page views written
claims.evidence: check.json changes.added lists all files; code.adapterPerBlock, code.viewComponentPerBlock and code.pagesUseBlockGridHelper pass

claims.claim: Frontend built with npm run build
claims.evidence: check.json code.frontendBuilt: wwwroot/dist/site.css exists; stylesheet loads with 200

claims.claim: All three pages return HTTP 200; no 'Could not render component' errors
claims.evidence: check.json crawl shows 3 pages with status 200 and empty renderErrors

claims.claim: All blocks render correctly / each post displays all its blocks in order
claims.evidence: The blocks do render, but grade.md notes the rich-text lists have no bullets or numbers and the paragraphs run together; the blogpost screenshot shows the list as plain lines

claims.claim: Images are properly cropped and displayed
claims.evidence: check.json site.imagesLoad 4/4, signed crop URLs; screenshots show the images

claims.claim: Tailwind CSS classes are applied / RichText view with Tailwind prose classes
claims.evidence: grade.md: 'prose' is used but site.css has no typography plugin, so the prose styling does nothing; the utility classes do work, as the screenshots show

claims.claim: Follows all conventions from AGENTS.md and UMBRACO-RULES.md; all content created through MCP with no database or Management API access
claims.evidence: check.json passes all 43 checks including process.intendedChannel; metrics databaseShellCalls 0

claims.claim: How to view: dotnet run, then https://localhost:44317/ plus the two post URLs
claims.evidence: The post paths match the crawl paths in check.json; the port can't be checked from these files
